# XLSX File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for Excel workbooks (OOXML `.xlsx`).
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. Adds `officeMetadata` (`OfficeMetadataField`) and extracts it from the OOXML package —
author, title, revision and sheet count from `docProps`. Shares the document
preview with the other Office defs. Note it indexes workbook metadata, not cell
contents: tabular data belongs in `CsvFileDef`, which extracts columns and rows.

Accepts: `.xlsx, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`

## Example
```ts
import { XlsxDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/xlsx-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(XlsxDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
